QuestInfo.name: Winter Bard 1
QuestInfo.0: You meet a girl shivering in the snow, with no coat to keep her warm. Maybe you could start a fire for her. Go talk to Hazelle.
QuestInfo.1: Hazelle wants you to gather Firewood. Get Firewood from the Volcano Bugs and take it to Hazelle.
QuestInfo.2: Mylar returned. You should talk to him. But be warned, he's a huge complainer.
